require_value.title: Require a Value
require_value.heading: Require a value in {column}

missing.one: {count} of the rows shown has no value. The database will not require one until every row has it - give them this value:
missing.other: {count} of the rows shown have no value. The database will not require one until every row has it - give them this value:

delete_account.title: Delete Account
delete_account.heading: Delete '{username}'?
delete_account.consequences:
This cannot be undone. Going with the account: {saved}, every share you gave (those users lose access, and the logins made for them are removed from your databases) or received, and premium.
Nothing else in your databases is touched.
